spans.s:
गौण गौण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. गुण), subordinate,
secondary, unessential; metaphorical, figurative; second-
ary as applied to the month reckoned from full moon
to full moon; having qualities, attributive, adjective;
relating to multiplication or enumeration; गौणं
कर्म, the less immediate object of an action in a
sentence.
—गौण-त्व, अम्, n. the state of an adjec-
tive or subordinate word.
—गौण-पक्ष, अस्, m.
the minor or weaker side of an argument &c.

1. गौणिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the three
qualities (of सत्त्व, रजस्, and तमस्), having
qualities, relating to or connected with qualities;
subordinate.

गौणिक 2. गौणिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. गोणी), re-
sembling a sack.

गौण्य, अम्, n. subordination; the state of being
unessential &c.

गौण्य; add — the being a merit, excellence;
(अस्), m. merit, excellence.
